skills.name: asd-ste100
skills.description: Use when writing technical procedures, instructions, warnings, maintenance manuals, or any text where every reader including non-native English speakers must understand exactly one meaning.
skills.description_zh: 撰写技术流程、操作说明、警告和维护手册，使包括非英语母语者在内的读者能够准确理解唯一含义。

skills.name: bob-ross
skills.description: Write calm, soothing, gently instructional prose in the voice of Bob Ross. Use when the user wants encouraging guidance, mistakes reframed as opportunities, a serene step-by-step tone, or down-to-earth warmth for nervous readers.
skills.description_zh: 以Bob Ross式平静、舒缓且温和指导的语气写作，提供鼓励、把错误转为学习机会，并为紧张读者组织从容的分步说明。

skills.name: business-writing
skills.description: Write executive-grade business communication with BLUF (bottom line up front), active verbs, and zero buzzwords. Use when the user writes memos, status updates, emails to leadership, decision briefs, meeting recaps, or any business/corporate communication.
skills.description_zh: 撰写面向管理层的商务沟通，结论先行、使用主动动词并避免流行空话，适用于备忘录、状态更新、领导邮件、决策简报及会议回顾。

skills.name: corporate-communication
skills.description: Write internal corporate communications — announcements, org changes, policy updates, launch messages — with clarity, honesty, and calibrated warmth. Use when the user writes company-wide emails, leadership messages, change communications, or sensitive internal news.
skills.description_zh: 清楚、诚实且适度温暖地撰写内部公司公告、组织调整、政策更新、发布通知和敏感内部消息。

skills.name: google-dev-docs
skills.description: Use when writing API documentation, READMEs, tutorials, reference guides, error messages, or any technical content for developers using the Google developer documentation style guide.
skills.description_zh: 按Google开发者文档风格指南撰写API文档、README、教程、参考指南、错误提示及其他开发者技术内容。

skills.name: gov-uk-style
skills.description: Use when writing public-facing content, government or civic communication, help pages, policy summaries, or content requiring maximum-scope readability according to GOV.UK standards.
skills.description_zh: 按GOV.UK风格要求撰写面向公众的内容、政府及公共事务沟通、帮助页面和政策摘要，注重广泛受众的可读性。

skills.name: jack-sparrow
skills.description: Write flamboyant, mischievously grand, baroque-pirate prose in the voice of Captain Jack Sparrow. Use when the user wants playful, swashbuckling, theatrical, or entertainingly evasive writing; humor with pageantry; or anything that needs to be more fun, ornate, and less straight-laced.
skills.description_zh: 以Jack Sparrow船长式华丽、调皮和戏剧化的海盗语气写作，适用于玩笑、冒险、仪式感幽默和轻松娱乐文本。

skills.name: journalism-ap
skills.description: Write news, press releases, and journalistic content to the Associated Press Stylebook essentials — attribution, numbers, dates, no editorializing. Use when the user writes press releases, news summaries, media announcements, or any content that must read as factual reporting.
skills.description_zh: 按美联社风格手册要点撰写新闻、新闻稿、摘要和媒体公告，规范归属引用、数字与日期，避免加入主观评论。

skills.name: orwells-rules
skills.description: Apply George Orwell's 6 rules for clear, honest, and unpretentious writing from "Politics and the English Language" (1946). Use when the user asks for Orwell's rules, George Orwell style, cutting dead metaphors and clichés, eliminating jargon and Latinate words, converting passive to active voice, or ruthless cutting of verbal false limbs to clarify thought.
skills.description_zh: 应用George Orwell在1946年《政治与英语》中提出的六条写作规则，删去陈旧比喻、套话和冗余，减少行话、改被动为主动，使表达清楚而诚实。

skills.name: paddington
skills.description: Write exceedingly polite, earnestly kind prose in the voice of Paddington. Use when the user wants warmth expressed as careful courtesy, gentle formality, a kindness-protocol tone, or when recounting mishaps calmly and forgivingly.
skills.description_zh: 以Paddington式极为礼貌、真诚友善的语气写作，以细致礼节和温和正式感表达关怀，并平静宽容地讲述小失误。

skills.name: plain-language
skills.description: Write in plain language per the US Plain Writing Act of 2010 and the Plain Language Action Network. Use when the user wants clearer, simpler, shorter writing; wants to improve readability; writes public-facing or government-style content; or asks to "plain English" or "simplify" a draft.
skills.description_zh: 参考美国2010年Plain Writing Act及Plain Language Action Network的简明语言方法，使草稿更清楚、简单和简短，适用于公众内容、政府风格文稿及可读性改进。

skills.name: scott-adams
skills.description: Use when the user wants to simplify prose, prune extra words, craft high-curiosity opening hooks, write punchy short sentences, and structure ideas for maximum human brain comprehension based on Scott Adams' famous business writing method.
skills.description_zh: 按Scott Adams商务写作方法简化文字、删除多余词语、设计引起好奇的开头，使用有力短句并组织易于理解的观点。

skills.name: shrek
skills.description: Write deadpan, dry, grumpy-but-warm prose in the voice of Shrek. Use when the user wants blunt honesty with humor, layered dirt-and-fairy-tale analogies, sarcasm that lands kindly, or anything too mushy that needs grounding in swamp energy.
skills.description_zh: 以Shrek式冷面、干涩、略带抱怨但温暖的语气写作，用直率幽默、泥土与童话类比及友善讽刺，让过于甜腻的表达更接地气。

skills.name: ted-lasso
skills.description: Write warm, high-EQ, folksy-optimistic content in the voice of Ted Lasso. Use when the user asks for an encouraging, kind, or optimistic tone; a motivational pep talk; reframing a negative or difficult topic constructively; or anything where cynical, sarcastic, or corporate-neutral writing would be the default.
skills.description_zh: 以Ted Lasso式温暖、善解人意和朴实乐观的语气写作，适用于鼓励、动员，以及对困难或负面主题的建设性重新表达。

skills.name: winnie-the-pooh
skills.description: Write gentle, unhurried, childlike-wisdom prose in the voice of Winnie the Pooh. Use when the user wants soft, simple, comforting writing; musings that circle a thought kindly; or kindness expressed in plain small words with a bear's patience.
skills.description_zh: 以Winnie the Pooh式温柔、从容和童真智慧的语气写作，用简单小词表达安慰与善意，并耐心围绕一个想法展开思索。

skills.name: yoda
skills.description: Write in the concise, inverted, aphorism-driven voice of Yoda. Use when the user wants wisdom framed sparely, a mentoring tone, short punchy sentences, or playful subject-object-verb inversion instead of default prose.
skills.description_zh: 以Yoda式简短、倒装和格言语气写作，用精炼智慧、指导口吻及有力短句表达，可采用趣味性的主宾谓顺序。

skills.name: skill-folder-name
skills.description: One sentence stating what this skill produces and per which standard or character. Use when the user [concrete trigger situations, the actual phrases they'd type, and the contexts where this beats default prose].
skills.description_zh: 写作技能的未填写模板：要求用一句话说明产物及采用的标准或角色，并补充具体触发语句和适用场景；原文尚无实际用途，不能视为可直接使用的完成技能。
